title: Urgent Password Reset Link
description: You receive an email from 'IT-Support <support@company-verify.com>' stating your email account password will expire in 15 minutes unless reset immediately via the attached link.
prompt: What is the safest action to take?
options: Click the link immediately and update your password
Verify the sender email domain and contact internal IT support directly
Forward the email to all colleagues to warn them
correct_answer: Verify the sender email domain and contact internal IT support directly
explanation: Legitimate corporate IT updates never come from external unverified domains requiring immediate password input.

title: Unexpected OTP Request Call
description: A caller claiming to be from your company helpdesk calls saying they are testing MFA systems and asks you to read aloud the 6-digit OTP code sent to your phone.
prompt: How should you respond to this call?
options: Provide the OTP since they identified themselves as IT helpdesk
Refuse to share the OTP, hang up, and report the incident to security
Ask them to confirm your employee ID before sharing the OTP
Read out half of the code to verify their identity
correct_answer: Refuse to share the OTP, hang up, and report the incident to security
explanation: One-Time Passwords (OTPs) are confidential single-use tokens. Support staff will NEVER ask for your OTP.
